evaluation_note: Attestations are semantic evidence tokens earned by regional settlement OR independent civic review of that interface. They are not affinity points, a demand to bind15Oaths or a mandatory boss-kill checklist.

records.name: Restoration
records.binding_requirement: None; all15 service interfaces must be represented, not all15 personally bound or equipped.
records.commitment: Revise the covenants into a coordinated plural charter with challenge, exit and maintenance provisions.
records.advantage: Preserves shared stability, cross-realm coordination and useful institutions while reducing exclusive claims.
records.cost: Requires recurring negotiation, funded oversight and compromises that leave some communities dissatisfied.
irreversible_personal_changes: The old exclusive charter is replaced in the player narrative.
Delegates and companions remember concessions and rejected demands.
records.shared_world_changes: Only approved recoverable event and service-state variants; no global ending overwrite.
records.failure_condition: Missing representation, unfunded essential service transition or contradictory unacknowledged promises.
records.fallback: Return to planning and obtain civic attestations without being forced into any Oath.

records.name: Dominion
records.binding_requirement: Selected dominant oath-01..15 must be reviewed and accepted as a narrative commitment; no requirement to equip its full castable set.
records.commitment: Give one selected Oath dominant authority over the revised covenant order while specifying protected minority services.
records.advantage: Creates clear responsibility and rapid coordinated action during a credible threat.
records.cost: Concentrates power, restricts plural authority and makes future correction depend on enforceable limits rather than benevolent leadership.
irreversible_personal_changes: One Oath becomes politically dominant in the player narrative.
Opponents may withdraw alliance; minority cultures and essential practices continue to exist.
records.shared_world_changes: Authored personal/party presentation and recoverable territory events; no deletion of otherOath content.
records.failure_condition: No selected dominant Oath, ignored minority continuity or undisclosed authority expansion.
records.fallback: Choose another reviewed dominant Oath or return to a different ending plan.

records.name: Liberation
records.binding_requirement: None; breaking compulsory claims does not require deleting learned powers or denying voluntary future covenants.
records.commitment: Dismantle the current compulsory covenant system through staged release and distributed replacement services.
records.advantage: Expands local and personal freedom and prevents inherited exclusive claims from governing every life.
records.cost: Creates transition uncertainty, coordination burdens and uneven local capacity; mutual aid must support communities without resources.
irreversible_personal_changes: Compulsory old claims cease in the player narrative.
Former institutions lose exclusive authority but their people, knowledge and voluntary practices remain.
records.shared_world_changes: Recoverable service-transition events and personal aftermath; no permanent world collapse or erased settlements.
records.failure_condition: No credible replacement for an essential interface or a plan that coerces supposedly liberated communities.
records.fallback: Develop missing service plans or adopt a different covenant settlement.
